eligibility: Local age of majority required. South Korea is not listed among prohibited locations; conflict-of-interest exclusions still apply.
required: Working application meaningfully using PayPal's free Sandbox and an AI tool/model in its functionality
Public GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repository with all source, run instructions and detectable open-source LICENSE
A functional hosted demo OR complete setup instructions; static mockups do not qualify
Public YouTube demonstration under 3 minutes, showing the application functioning
English submission, instructions and video or English translations
Free judge access through the end of judging, December 15, 2026
implementation_interpretation: AI-assisted coding alone is insufficient. Our runtime classifier is trained statistical ML and actively produces review suggestions. Fixture PayPal responses do not prove Sandbox integration; real Sandbox credentials and execution must be verified separately.
